title: MACE-guided screening yields three corundum high-entropy oxides and a cation-ordered oxide
summary: MACE-MP-0b2 interatomic-potential calculations screened 462 four- and five-cation trivalent-oxide compositions and selected 16 for synthesis. Experiments produced three phase-pure corundum high-entropy oxides—(Al,Cr,Fe,Ga)₂O₃, (Al,Cr,Fe,Rh,Sc)₂O₃ and (Cr,Fe,Ga,Rh,Sc)₂O₃—and a separate phase-pure cation-ordered (Al,Fe,Ga,Sc)₂O₃ oxide. The ordered compound crystallized in orthorhombic Pba2; its precise cation-site occupancies were not resolved conclusively by powder diffraction.

evidence.tested: MACE-MP-0b2 interatomic-potential calculations screened 462 four- and five-cation trivalent-oxide compositions and selected 16 for synthesis.
evidence.unknown: This is an unrefereed arXiv preprint. Only three of 16 tested compositions formed phase-pure corundum high-entropy oxides; most attempts produced competing phases, and rhodium-containing samples showed redox instability. Synthesis outcomes depended strongly on route: the three corundum HEOs were phase-pure only with one of solid-state or combustion synthesis. The ordered oxide’s structure is supported by powder diffraction/Rietveld refinement, but exact site preferences could not be conclusively determined from pXRD. The screening supports candidate ranking, not reliable prediction of phase purity or synthesis conditions for arbitrary HEOs.
evidence.ai_role: The MLIP relaxed approximately 1,000-atom disordered supercells and estimated mixing enthalpy and atom-energy-distribution descriptors for the 462-composition search. The authors combined these with a stability metric to rank 16 synthesis candidates. Experimental powder-X-ray diffraction and Rietveld refinement then assessed the predicted materials, linking model-guided selection to the new synthesized compositions.
